invariants: Every legacy generated task is typed as paths or legacy_deferred without inferring ownership.
Every legacy finalized task membership is projected to the durable item-level snapshot.
PostgreSQL enforces non-null scope state membership with a validated check constraint.
Terminal historical items remain terminal and receive scope metadata only.
Repeat apply preserves row counts and leaves scope diagnostics stable.
Runtime publication, activation, and dispatch reject pending, contradictory, or legacy-deferred scope.
attestation.residual_risk_notes: Legacy empty task budgets are preserved as typed legacy_deferred state so fleet migration completes without guessing path ownership. Runtime gates keep those tasks dormant until an operator replaces deferred scope with paths or an explicit no_files declaration and finalizes the plan.
